description: This file defines the CursorConnection class, which extends AbstractCursorHandler and provides methods to create cursor-based database connections, prepare statements, and create statements with cursor handling support.

classes.name: CursorConnection
classes.description: Provides cursor-based connection handling, including creation of cursor-aware prepared statements and statements for database interactions.

methods.name: newCursorConnection
methods.description: Creates a new cursor-based connection wrapper around an existing JDBC Connection, associated with a cursor name and page size.

methods.name: CursorConnection (constructor)
methods.description: Initializes the CursorConnection instance with a JDBC Connection, cursor name, and fetch size.

methods.name: invoke
methods.description: Overrides method to intercept calls to prepareStatement and createStatement for cursor handling and debugging.
